analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a 'watchful' stance for the third consecutive day. RSI is exiting oversold territory (30.6 → 43.0), but MACD histogram remains negative and is improving (-0.6125 → -0.3465), indicating weak trend reversal signals. The 5-day price change (+0.39%) also shows a lack of strong direction, continuing the sideways consolidation, thus requiring further confirmation.

· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 $114.61) — 중단 부근에서 횡보하며 방향성 부재 확인
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($110.76) — 52주 저가($105.19)와 피벗 S1($107.15) 기반으로 한 주요 지지 구간

· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (5일 저가↑, 5일 고가↓) — Higher Low와 Lower High가 혼재된 횡보 패턴 진단

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($112.04) vs SMA5/20/50 ($111.28/$114.61/$115.96) — Above short-term SMA5 but below mid-term SMA20/50, confirming entry into a consolidation phase.
· Below SMA100/200 ($115.07/$116.70) — Signaling weakening in the medium to long-term trend.
· 52-week position (34.6%) + Current price is approximately 6% above the 52-week low ($105.19).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.6 → 43.0) — Exiting oversold territory and attempting to enter the neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (histo -0.6125 → -0.3465) — Improving within the negative territory, indicating weakening bearish momentum.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $114.61) — Trading sideways around the middle band, confirming a lack of directional momentum.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($110.76) — Key support zone based on the 52-week low ($105.19) and Pivot S1 ($107.15).
· Swing Resistance ($113.67) — Short-term resistance zone based on the 5-day high ($113.59) and Pivot PP ($113.18).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (5-day low ↑, 5-day high ↓) — Diagnosed as a sideways pattern with mixed Higher Low and Lower High signals.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.45x) — Significantly subdued volume compared to the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of price movements.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — Despite RSI's attempt to exit oversold and MACD's improvement signals, maintaining a 'watchful' stance due to lack of volume and sideways pattern. Consider buying upon a break above the swing resistance ($113.67).
analysis.patternNote: 5일 고가와 저가가 모두 좁은 범위 내에서 움직이며 뚜렷한 방향성을 보이지 않는 횡보 패턴이 지속되고 있다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: A persistent sideways pattern is observed, with both 5-day highs and lows trading within a narrow range, indicating a lack of clear directional movement.
keyPoints: RSI가 과매도 구간(30.6)에서 벗어나 43.0까지 상승하며 반등 가능성을 시사한다.
MACD 히스토그램이 개선되는(-0.6125 → -0.3465) 추세는 약세 모멘텀 약화를 보여주지만, 여전히 음수 구간에 머물러 추세 전환으로 보기에는 이르다.
거래량 비율이 0.45로 현저히 위축되어 있어 현재 가격 움직임의 신뢰도가 낮다.
keyPointsEn: RSI is moving up from oversold territory (30.6) to 43.0, suggesting potential for a rebound.
The improving MACD histogram (-0.6125 → -0.3465) indicates weakening bearish momentum, but remaining in negative territory suggests it's too early to confirm a trend reversal.
The volume ratio of 0.45 is significantly subdued, lowering the reliability of current price movements.
analysis.riskNote: ADX가 13.5로 추세가 형성되지 않은 구간에서 거래량 없이 횡보하고 있어, 언제든 급격한 변동이 발생할 수 있다.
